description: Curated probes for retrieval-strategy ablation (baseline vs flare vs hyde vs multi_query). Use with library=public on an indexed corpus.

cases.query: Summarize the main topics covered in the indexed articles. Cite **Article title** for each theme.
Compare how two or more articles describe a shared theme. Use a markdown table: Theme | **Article title** | Detail | Limitation.
What scientific or technical concepts appear in the retrieved passages? One sentence each with **Article title**.
List dates, years, or time periods stated in the excerpts and what they refer to. Include **Article title** per bullet.
What geographical locations (cities, countries, regions) are mentioned? Bullet list with **Article title**.
Do any passages disagree on the same topic? Summarize neutrally with **Article title**, or state they align.
Extract numerical facts from the context only. Table: Value | What it refers to | **Article title**.
If passages describe a process or workflow, outline steps as a checklist; otherwise say no process is described.
